title: The 'sunken shrine' and 'old watchtower' verse locations were never surfaced by any NPC dialogue or exploration despite fairly exhaustive coverage of the Vale — no compass/hint pointed at where to look, unlike the barrow-hall verse and the hunter's-camp tally clue for the hidden barrow entrance.
